title: Inventory Verification
description: Output of one independent verification agent (or the missing-feature hunter). Patches are applied to inventory parts by apply_verification.py. Every patch and verdict carries file:line evidence. A replace patch on a list field must name the exact old item; it swaps one item and never collapses the list.

scope.description: Scope id from verification/scopes.json; also the file name.

flow_complete.description: Whether the feature's flow (after patches) covers every step the code implements.

feature_id.description: Existing feature id, or the new id for field=new_feature.

field.description: Every feature field is patchable. Do not encode a field inside another field's value.

action.description: add/remove items of a list field; replace one list item (old required) or a scalar field. new_feature uses add.

value.description: One item, a list of items (add/remove), a screen object (screens), or a full feature object (new_feature). Never a multi-value string.

old.description: Required for replace on a list field: the exact existing item being replaced. For scalar fields, the current value (optional).

evidence.description: path/File.swift:line - what the code shows. A line number is required.

issue.description: The known_issues text being checked (a prefix is enough).

missing_features.description: Short description + evidence for each feature missing from the inventory. Each one also needs a new_feature patch.

summary.description: What was checked and the main corrections.
